text: In 2018, NASA's Opportunity sent its final dataset. The mission ended. The story didn't.
The archive holds extraordinary discoveries — but its language was built for experts.
ECHOES turns that archive into a world a child can explore alone.
Start in the solar system. Choose Mars. Travel from orbit to the rover.
Planned for 90 days. It explored for over 14 years and crossed 45.16 kilometers.
Its final image was incomplete. What it found was not.
Not just watching science. Asking the questions science asks.
Built for classrooms, teachers, and families.
The signal ends. The light continues.
